remarks: Welcome home to this tastefully renovated two bed two bath condo in a great location in Hudson Village. Nestled at the end of the quiet hall sharing only 1 wall with a neighbour. The LARGE BALCONY has a hookup for gas BBQ, creating a great outdoor space for entertaining. Relax at a patio set or lounge chairs to watch sunrises, sunsets, stargazing, and even fireworks shows on Canada Day & New year's Day. With no buildings obstructing the view you can see the all the way to downtown. The building has great outer wall soundproofing so road noise is hardly noticeable. Located at the end of a short street, traffic is minimal with lots of parking space along the street if all the visitor parking is full. This building is secure with an enclosed perimeter fence so foot traffic is kept to a minimum. There are multiple walking paths in the area, with plenty of green spaces and 3 man-made lakes within walking distance. Easy access to Henday and St Albert Tr, shops, entertainment & amenities.
